diagrams.scope: Fresh full-extent headless Chrome rendering of the pinned source Mermaid in default and dark themes; not a live Guide or OnCo page check.

findings.finding: The bracket labelled CAR ends near the membrane and does not encompass the green intracellular signalling region. The chapter correctly describes the complete receptor; a bracket spanning all components would avoid a narrower visual reading.
findings.action: Caption/illustration-owner clarification queued; not silently treated as evidence that the signalling region is outside the CAR.

findings.finding: The dark variant explicitly adds Supportive receptor can help, while the light version depicts the supportive input without that sentence. Conditional help is not a measured benefit, access or safety result.
findings.action: Retain BAR context/function and PRO feature-control requirements; do not claim identical text across themes.

findings.finding: Complete-product wraps within the word in the standalone Mermaid output; all nodes and arrowheads remain visible.
findings.action: Standalone-render legibility note, not a live Guide-site defect claim.
